big_case.notes: Individual state non-capital attempted-murder prosecution presenting an idiosyncratic trial-record dispute—where the trial judge twice denied sufficiency directed-verdict motions before dismissing on Sixth Amendment compulsory-process grounds over an out-of-state conservatorship ward's nonappearance while adding a 'Judgment of Acquittal' label. No genuine split, zero amici, next-day response waiver by Mississippi, and routine first-conference denial without noted dissent.
